name: infinite-zoom-words
title: Infinite Zoom Words
description: The camera zooms through nested frames. Each frame holds one word of a phrase and a smaller frame with the next word inside it; the zoom steps in word by word and ends on the last frame, which holds the final word and a lockup line. Words and lockup come from variables.
useWhen: A short phrase or slogan revealed one word at a time with a sense of going deeper.
An opening line that ends on a shop name or tagline.
avoidWhen: Long sentences: keep each word short and the phrase to 3 to 6 words.
A plain headline reveal: use per-character-rise.
author: Mosio

variables.label: Words
variables.description: The phrase: words separated by | or new lines (a single line without | splits on spaces). 2 to 6 words; the last one is the final lockup frame.

variables.label: Lockup line
variables.description: Small line under the last word, e.g. the shop name. Empty hides it.

variables.label: Frame ratio
variables.description: Size of each nested frame relative to the one around it (smaller zooms deeper per step).

variables.label: Main colour
variables.description: The final word: the one accent.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Google Fonts family name; Geist is loaded, others only if the host loads them.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
